title: Open the guard's config from four fixed slots to any configured role
action: Per D2 (store 06e49368), the model-guard must ask 'is this role configured', never 'is this one of four words'. Today its config is a FIXED STRUCT, not a map: model_guard.rs:256-269 declares Models/Slots with named fields, :374-395 normalizes literal per-field defaults, and configured_model_set hardcodes [extraction, generation, review] at :495 and :510. This is the hard dependency for the whole feature: a model configured under models.claude.test fails the membership check at :797-811 and DENIES, so no cell work can land until this opens. Rewrite the guard's config layer to a map keyed by role name, and derive the member set from what the resolver can publish rather than from a literal list. Retire CLAUDE_TIERS and CODEX_TIERS (:192-193) as hand-maintained closed lists — they have already drifted, 4 entries against 5, with no behavior intending it; the [bee-tier] marker parser (:195-224) must accept any configured role name. Keep the deny loud: a marker naming a role nothing configures still refuses, with a FIX line naming the remedy. Do not touch PINNED_AGENT_TYPE or dispatch_kind_for_tier — those belong to the later agent-name rebase.

truths: A role configured outside the old three slots passes configured_model_set instead of denying
The guard holds no hardcoded list of legal tier or role names
A [bee-tier: any configured role] marker is accepted; an unconfigured one still refuses with a FIX line
The guard's member set is derived from what the resolver can publish, not maintained beside it
The full suite is green, with the retarget/delete split named on the cap for each tier-touching guard test

deviations: CLAUDE_TIERS/CODEX_TIERS retired: a [bee-tier: <role>] marker naming a role nothing configures now REFUSES by name (transports role-not-configured / codex-spawn-role-unconfigured) where it used to read as no marker and fall to the bare/unmarked deny — louder, per D2 "warned, never silently accepted"
advisor is now a legal marker name on claude too (it was legal on codex only — the 4-vs-5 drift D2 names), because known_roles derives from slot_for_kind over DISPATCH_KINDS

pinned_type_for now returns Option and the general-purpose repair is skipped for a role with no rendered agent: its old unwrap_or("undefined") was unreachable under four names and would have rewritten subagent_type to a non-existent type under an open set. PINNED_AGENT_TYPE and dispatch_kind_for_tier are untouched, as the cell scoped

configured_model_set drops its separate resolve_advisor call: after mrs-2, resolve_tier reads the advisor slot directly and advisor is one of the walked config keys, so the second read was the same value

No guard test needed retargeting or deleting — all 38 existing tests pass unchanged; 6 new tests cover the open set (derived known-role set, a role outside the old three slots as a member, any-configured-role marker, unconfigured-role refusal on both runtimes, no undefined repair)
